verdict.rationale: Greenhouse ships built-in AI features that take over specific recruiting tasks. Notetaker records, transcribes and maps notes to scorecards inside the product. Voice AI runs first-round voice interviews on recruiters' behalf. Talent Matching tiers applications, and the reports offer AI-powered filters. However, these are fixed, single-purpose automations rather than a general assistant you can hand arbitrary tasks to. missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product AI assistant or agent that accepts open-ended delegated tasks, documentation of how users assign tasks to it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
